parts.stem: Put the following method steps in order so that they describe how to prepare a microscope slide of onion cells.

items.value: Take an internal part from the onion.
Add a drop of water to the epidermis.
Place the epidermis so it lays flat on the glass microscope slide.
Carefully pull off one epidermis thin layer or tissue.

correct_answer: Take an internal part from the onion.
Carefully pull off one epidermis thin layer or tissue.
Place the epidermis so it lays flat on the glass microscope slide.
Add a drop of water to the epidermis.
